title: Turn complex work into a system people can operate.
summary: A systems-practice service map for evidence-heavy, judgment-sensitive work, organized around leadership, research, content, legal workflows, governed agents, implementation, fractional ownership, and licensing.
audience: Regulated, reputation-sensitive, or institutionally complex organizations choosing the smallest useful route from ambiguity to an inspectable working system.

collection.heading: Choose the recurring problem, consequential decision, or body of expertise that needs stronger structure.

deliverables: Source hierarchy, taxonomy, definitions, and verification procedure
User, stakeholder, workflow, decision, escalation, and approval maps
Test cases, evaluation, governance, documentation, training, and handoff or licensing package
timeline: Commercial paths begin with a contained Systems Audit, move into architecture only when needed, then proceed to a working build, fractional ownership, or licensing when the evidence supports expansion.
fit: Information is fragmented or difficult to verify
Rules, exceptions, and professional judgment matter
The team repeats the same research, review, intake, or decision work
A service or methodology could become a reusable product
A working pilot is needed before larger software investment
evidence: Current work as it actually happens
Source materials, users, recurring decisions, exceptions, bottlenecks, risks, tools, and owners
Methods, builds, engagement structures, tests, and acceptance records
methodology: Audit the current system and decision rights
Define the source model, data structure, rules, review, interface, governance, and implementation plan
Build and test the smallest working system
Document human responsibility, unknowns, and dependencies
Operate, transfer, maintain, or license only after acceptance
assumptions: A decision maker and accountable internal owner participate
Required data, source access, review capacity, and technical dependencies are made explicit
limitations: The practice does not replace licensed professional judgment
A different partner may be required for commodity web work, standard configuration, or large-scale engineering staff augmentation
